ValidationRule.description: To ensure that all the Channel Assets must have Channel member and Subscription Date available on the Account before they register to Channel
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Agency_Channel', NOT(ISBLANK(AccountId)), Account.RecordType.DeveloperName = "Agency_Account", OR( Account.Channel_Member__c = FALSE, ISBLANK(Account.Channel_Subscription_Date__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Account should be subscribed to Channel
